patch_description: Fundamentally different internal pipeline: a robust constant-velocity Kalman + RTS smoother for the trend estimate, followed by a *volatility-blended two-kernel zero-phase SG cascade* instead of fixed multi-pass smoothing. Two precomputed SG kernels (narrow `h1` and wide `h2`) are blended per-sample with a sigmoid weight of local volatility (smoothed |diff|): in quiet regions the output is dominated by the narrow kernel (responsiveness, low lag), while in volatile regions the wide kernel takes over (suppressing noise-induced slope reversals and false reversals). A final light zero-phase polish pass removes residual ripple, and a mild slope-lead term restores corner dynamics lost to wide-kernel attenuation. All stages are O(n) convolutions plus the O(n) Kalman recursion, keeping execution time near the previous best. The adaptive blend directly targets the smoothness/false-reversal bottleneck (weakest metrics at 0.29/0.24) without sacrificing the strong correlation (0.95+) and lag (0.27) already achieved, because kernel widening happens only where the signal is genuinely volatile.
